summary: Created a 6-phase, ~7-hour implementation plan extending lint-state-writer-boundary.sh (gate 12) to the Python/interpreter re-serialization channel. Phases 1-3 extract a shared predicate library, add the candidate limb plus write-capable-mode classify branch, extend the remedy message, and pin every named shape, control case, and a corruption-reproduction fixture in the lint suite. Phases 4-5 add the companion PreToolUse Bash hook (the research-settled answer: the originating incident was an ad hoc interpreter call no content lint could see), its both-polarity test, fragment-surface registration, and the task-lock.md pointer sentence. Phase 6 redeploys and runs the full gate battery under an explicit source-store TARGET with gate 12's runtime measured.
